study: Stevens & Slavin 1995 — Cooperative Elementary School (CES: CIRC reading + TAI math + cooperative learning), QED matched-school, grades 2-6, reading & math
delivery_evidence: Teachers received face-to-face training (initial training in August with subsequent on-site training during the year) plus ongoing in-school peer coaching and collaborative teacher/administrator planning meetings (Method; 'teachers using peer coaching, teachers planning cooperatively'). 1995 study, no online component.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are California Achievement Test (CAT) Form E subtests (Reading Vocabulary/Comprehension, Language, Math Computation/Application) — a broad nationally-standardised independent achievement battery not tailored to CES (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 1).
curriculum_evidence: CES adopts the Johns Hopkins cooperative learning programs as curriculum: CIRC (reading/language arts) and TAI (math), which come with instructional materials, teachers' manuals, and other materials that teachers then use ('given training, materials, follow-up... to use the Johns Hopkins cooperative learning' programs).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effects are the spring Year-2 posttests, the end of the 2-year study/intervention (extraction timepoint=post, spring Year 2, end of study).
